class Stack
  def initialize
    @data = []
  end

  def push(item)
    @data.push(item)
  end

  def pop
    @data.pop
  end

  def empty?
    @data.empty?
  end
end

s = Stack.new
s.push(10)
s.push(20)
puts s.pop

function flatten(array $arr): array {
    $result = [];
    array_walk_recursive($arr, function($val) use (&$result) {
        $result[] = $val;
    });
    return $result;
}

$nested = [1, [2, 3], [4, [5, 6]]];
print_r(flatten($nested));

#!/bin/bash

backup_dir="./backups"
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"

for file in *.log; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        cp "$file" "$backup_dir/${file%.log}_$(date +%Y%m%d).log"
        echo "Backed up $file"
    fi
done

function map(tbl, fn)
  local result = {}
  for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
    result[i] = fn(v)
  end
  return result
end

local nums = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
local squares = map(nums, function(x) return x * x end)
for _, v in ipairs(squares) do
  print(v)
end

module Main where

fib :: Int -> Int
fib 0 = 0
fib 1 = 1
fib n = fib (n - 1) + fib (n - 2)

main :: IO ()
main = mapM_ print [fib n | n <- [0..9]]

# Compute summary stats for a numeric vector
data <- c(4, 7, 2, 9, 1, 5, 8, 3, 6)

cat("Mean:", mean(data), "\n")
